guard/30580.htm.text: Centurion Parugon: I, Parugon, am a Centurion, charged with guarding the Immortal Plateau and Orc Village. Northeast of the Northern Immortal Plateau, you'll find the Frozen Waterfalls . Could this portend the inevitable Eternal Winter that caused such an influx onto the Immortal Plateau?
